title: The reply
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Wood writes back. Four drafts. The strip shows none of them.

panels.composition: The table. A postcard of Small Wood — the only one the drugstore sells: the bay, faded. WOOD with a pen. BARNABY asleep.

image.prompt: a young man at a drawing table holding a pen over a blank faded postcard of a bay, a dog asleep under the table, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The wastebasket. One postcard. Then two. Then three. Drawn as a stack.

image.prompt: close-up of a wastebasket with three crumpled postcards in it, one more falling

panels.composition: Wood, on the fourth. Writing fast. We see only the back of his hand.

characters.pose: writing fast, hand covering the card

image.prompt: a young man writing fast on a postcard with his hand covering the words, seen from the side

panels.composition: The card in the mailbox slot, going in. The front: the bay. Whatever it says is inside the box now.

image.prompt: close-up of a hand sliding a postcard of a bay into a blue mailbox slot, no words
image.notes: Four drafts, none shown. The rule: the reader infers.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox
